async detail(
    id: number,
    actor: FieldAgentActorContext,
    includeDeleted = false,
  ) {
    const row = await this.agent(id, actor, includeDeleted);
    const org = await this.db
      .getRepository(OrganizationEntity)
      .findOneByOrFail({ id: row.organizationId });
    const user = row.userId
      ? await this.db
          .getRepository(UserEntity)
          .findOneBy({ id: row.userId, organizationId: row.organizationId })
      : null;
    return {
      id: row.id,
      organization_id: row.organizationId,
      organization_name: org.tradeName || org.legalName,
      user_id: row.userId,
      name: row.name,
      email: row.email,
      phone: row.phone,
      document: row.document,
      status: row.status,
      metadata: row.metadata,
      created_at: row.createdAt.toISOString(),
      updated_at: row.updatedAt.toISOString(),
      deleted_at: row.deletedAt?.toISOString() ?? null,
      linked_user: user
        ? {
            id: user.id,
            full_name: user.fullName,
            login: user.login,
            email: user.email,
            status: user.status,
          }
        : null,
    };
  }

async overview(
    filters: OrganizationOverviewQueryDto,
    actor: ProjectActorContext,
  ) {
    await this.authorizeFilters(filters, actor);
    const query = this.query(filters, actor);
    const [totals, statuses, timeline, projects, geography, located] =
      await Promise.all([
        query
          .clone()
          .select('COUNT(*)', 'total')
          .addSelect(
            'SUM(CASE WHEN p.status = :openStatus THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)',
            'open',
          )
          .setParameter('openStatus', ProjectStatus.ACTIVE)
          .getRawOne<{ total: string; open: string }>(),
        query
          .clone()
          .select('p.status', 'status')
          .addSelect('COUNT(*)', 'total')
          .groupBy('p.status')
          .getRawMany<{ status: string; total: string }>(),
        query
          .clone()
          .select("DATE_FORMAT(p.created_at, '%Y-%m')", 'period')
          .addSelect('COUNT(*)', 'total')
          .groupBy("DATE_FORMAT(p.created_at, '%Y-%m')")
          .orderBy('period', 'ASC')
          .getRawMany<{ period: string; total: string }>(),
        query
          .clone()
          .select(['p.id', 'p.name', 'p.status', 'p.createdAt'])
          .orderBy('p.created_at', 'DESC')
          .addOrderBy('p.id', 'DESC')
          .take(50)
          .getMany(),
        query
          .clone()
          .innerJoin(
            'project_units',
            'pu',
            'pu.project_id = p.id AND pu.organization_id = p.organization_id AND pu.deleted_at IS NULL',
          )
          .innerJoin(
            'company_units',
            'cu',
            'cu.id = pu.company_unit_id AND cu.organization_id = p.organization_id AND cu.deleted_at IS NULL',
          )
          .select('UPPER(TRIM(cu.state))', 'state')
          .addSelect('COUNT(DISTINCT p.id)', 'total')
          .andWhere('UPPER(TRIM(cu.state)) IN (:...ufs)', { ufs: UFS })
          .groupBy('UPPER(TRIM(cu.state))')
          .getRawMany<{ state: string; total: string }>(),
        query
          .clone()
          .andWhere(
            `EXISTS (SELECT 1 ${UNIT_LINK} AND UPPER(TRIM(cu.state)) IN (:...ufs))`,
            { ufs: UFS },
          )
          .getCount(),
      ]);
    const total = Number(totals?.total ?? 0);
    const open = Number(totals?.open ?? 0);
    return {
      total_projects: total,
      open_projects: open,
      open_percentage: total ? Math.round((open / total) * 10000) / 100 : 0,
      total_contract_value: null,
      average_contract_value: null,
      open_contract_value: null,
      contracted_items: null,
      statuses: statuses.map((row) => ({
        status: row.status,
        total: Number(row.total),
      })),
      timeline: timeline.map((row) => ({
        period: row.period,
        total: Number(row.total),
      })),
      geography: geography.map((row) => ({
        state: row.state,
        total: Number(row.total),
      })),
      unlocated_projects: total - located,
      projects: projects.map((p) => ({
        id: p.id,
        name: p.name,
        status: p.status,
        created_at: p.createdAt,
      })),
    };
  }

async listPlateHistory(
    projectId: number,
    itemId: number,
    query: InventoryOperationListQueryDto,
    actor: InventoryOperationActor,
  ) {
    const project = await this.getProject(projectId, actor, false);
    await this.requireItem(projectId, itemId);
    const total = await this.plateHistory.count({
      where: {
        organizationId: project.organizationId,
        projectId,
        inventoryItemId: itemId,
      },
    });
    const items = await this.plateHistory
      .createQueryBuilder('plate')
      .leftJoin(
        InventoryObservationEntity,
        'observation',
        'observation.id = plate.observation_id AND observation.project_id = :projectId',
        { projectId },
      )
      .leftJoin(
        InventoryRoundEntity,
        'round',
        'round.id = observation.round_id AND round.project_id = :projectId',
        { projectId },
      )
      .select('plate.id', 'id')
      .addSelect('plate.inventory_item_id', 'inventory_item_id')
      .addSelect('plate.observation_id', 'observation_id')
      .addSelect('plate.previous_plate', 'previous_plate')
      .addSelect('plate.observed_plate', 'observed_plate')
      .addSelect('plate.source', 'source')
      .addSelect('plate.recorded_by_id', 'recorded_by_id')
      .addSelect('plate.created_at', 'created_at')
      .addSelect('observation.session_id', 'session_id')
      .addSelect('observation.round_id', 'round_id')
      .addSelect('round.round_number', 'round_number')
      .addSelect('observation.captured_at', 'captured_at')
      .addSelect('observation.field_agent_id', 'field_agent_id')
      .where('plate.organization_id = :organizationId', {
        organizationId: project.organizationId,
      })
      .andWhere('plate.project_id = :projectId', { projectId })
      .andWhere('plate.inventory_item_id = :itemId', { itemId })
      .orderBy('plate.created_at', 'ASC')
      .addOrderBy('plate.id', 'ASC')
      .offset((query.page - 1) * query.page_size)
      .limit(query.page_size)
      .getRawMany<Record<string, unknown>>();
    return this.paginate(items, query, total);
  }

async create(
    projectId: number,
    dto: CreateInventoryPendingIssueDto,
    actor: InventoryPendingIssueActorContext,
  ): Promise<InventoryPendingIssueResponseDto> {
    const project = await this.getProject(projectId, actor, true);
    await this.assertLinkedItems(
      project.organizationId,
      projectId,
      dto.inventory_item_id ?? null,
      dto.accounting_item_id ?? null,
      actor,
    );
    await this.assertNoOpenDuplicate(
      project.organizationId,
      projectId,
      dto.type,
      dto.inventory_item_id ?? null,
      dto.accounting_item_id ?? null,
    );

    const now = new Date();
    const issue = new InventoryPendingIssue({
      id: 0,
      organizationId: project.organizationId,
      projectId,
      inventoryItemId: dto.inventory_item_id ?? null,
      accountingItemId: dto.accounting_item_id ?? null,
      type: dto.type,
      status: InventoryPendingIssueStatus.OPEN,
      severity: dto.severity ?? InventoryPendingIssueSeverity.MEDIUM,
      title: this.scope.cleanText(dto.title) ?? dto.title,
      description: this.scope.cleanText(dto.description) ?? null,
      oldValue: dto.old_value ?? null,
      newValue: dto.new_value ?? null,
      resolutionNotes: null,
      resolvedById: null,
      resolvedAt: null,
      ignoredById: null,
      ignoredAt: null,
      createdById: actor.id,
      updatedById: actor.id,
      metadata: dto.metadata ?? null,
      createdAt: now,
      updatedAt: now,
      deletedAt: null,
    });

    const saved = await this.repository.saveWithAudit(issue, {
      inventoryPendingIssueId: 0,
      organizationId: issue.organizationId,
      projectId: issue.projectId,
      operation: InventoryPendingIssueAuditOperation.CREATE,
      performedBy: actor.id,
      changes: { status: { before: null, after: issue.status } },
    });
    return InventoryPendingIssueResponseDto.fromDomain(saved);
  }
